item.title: Philadelphia, NJ forecast: Warmer 50s today, light snow possible Tuesday before rain
item.description: After a cold start, Philadelphia will see sunny skies and highs in the 50s today. A quick round of light snow Tuesday morning could switch to rain.

item.title: PA lawmakers react to US strikes on Iran: 'Americans don't want war'
item.description: The United States and Israel carried out a massive military operation early Saturday, with President Donald Trump confirming that Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed in the strikes. The attacks Saturday were carried out without the approval of Congress. Even before the bombs fell Saturday, both Democrats and Republicans in Congress had planned votes to try and rein in the President's war powers. item.description: A motorcyclist is dead after a tow truck incident in Philadelphia's Frankford neighborhood this weekend, and now police are looking for a driver they say fled the scene.An SUV was being towed on the 4000 block of Frankford Avenue when it suddenly detached around 4:15 p.m. Saturday.The detached SUV then rolled back and crashed into a motorcyclist, who died at a local hospital a short time later. item.title: SEPTA to implement trolley cameras March 2, $51 fines begin April 1
item.description: Starting March 2, SEPTA trolleys on Lines T1–T5 and G1 will use automated cameras to catch vehicles blocking lanes or stopping zones.

item.title: Family seeks justice 5 years after Chuckie Maude's murder in Philadelphia
item.description: As the 5th anniversary of Chuckie Maude's death nears, his family continues to seek justice and has started a nonprofit to help others facing similar loss.
